claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows PS5 logo band on every spine, not PS4 cases
Witness only reports used-looking cases on a shelf; no new/sealed item shown
Delivery capability cannot be seen in a photo

risks.risk: Disc surface condition and playability unknown (scratches, read errors)
risks.proof: Close-up photo or video of each disc's data side
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily scratched / playability not guaranteed

risks.risk: Cases may be empty or missing manuals/inlays
risks.proof: Photo of each case opened showing disc and inlay present

risks.risk: Platform mismatch claim (seller says PS4, photos show PS5 cases) could indicate wrong listing or mixed lot
risks.proof: Seller confirms platform on camera or shows console compatibility sticker clearly
risks.if_unproven: priced strictly as PS5 lot per witness, ignoring seller's PS4 claim

risks.risk: Exact title count and duplicates (e.g. two FC25 copies) unclear
risks.proof: Full inventory photo with each spine laid out and legible
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower count of clearly identified titles only

risks.risk: Region lock / disc authenticity (pirated or resurfaced discs) cannot be assessed remotely
risks.proof: Photo of disc hub/printing and verifiable seller storefront reviews
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified authenticity, worst case treated as possible non-original

proof_requests: Open each case and photograph the disc and any inlay/manual
Close-up, well-lit shot of each disc's playing surface
Seller to state and show on video which platform (PS4 or PS5) the lot actually is
Legible photo of the shelf price tag
Full clear list/photo of all titles and quantities, avoiding duplicates confusion
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a lot of used PS5 game cases, so it can be priced at worst case for unknown disc condition and completeness, while the seller's PS4 claim is flagged as contradicted and ignored for identity purposes.
